summary: Completed testing of P0 UI/UX improvements for Parking Reservation App. All 4 feature areas verified: (1) Admin Reservations - 6 stat cards + No Show filter + building filter, (2) Admin User Management - pagination with PAGE_SIZE=15 + search/filter reset, (3) Admin Building Management - summary stats + search, (4) Attendant Dashboard - building filter (hidden when ≤1 building assigned, which is correct behavior).
critical_code_review_comments: Admin Reservations has all 6 stat cards with correct data-testid attributes (stat-total, stat-pending, stat-confirmed, stat-completed, stat-no-show, stat-cancelled)
Status filter dropdown correctly includes 'No Show' option that filters reservations
Building filter dropdown works correctly for Admin Reservations
User Management pagination shows 'Showing X-Y of Z users' with PAGE_SIZE=15
Search and filter correctly reset currentPage to 1 via useEffect hook
Building Management summary stats (Buildings, Floors, Total Slots, Available) render correctly
Search by building name or address works in Building Management
Attendant building filter only appears when attendant has >1 assigned buildings (code: buildings.length > 1)
Backend endpoints /api/attendant/buildings and /api/attendant/daily-reservations with building_id param work correctly
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 UI improvements all verified. Key data-testid selectors: Admin Reservations (stat-total, stat-pending, stat-confirmed, stat-completed, stat-no-show, stat-cancelled, filter-status, filter-building), User Management (user-management-page, user-pagination, prev-page-btn, next-page-btn, page-{n}, search-users-input, role-filter), Building Management (building-management-page, total-buildings, total-floors, total-slots, available-slots, search-buildings-input), Attendant Dashboard (attendant-dashboard, building-filter-select, pending-count, confirmed-count, no-show-count, date-selector, prev-day-btn, next-day-btn). Attendant building filter only shows when >1 building assigned - this is expected behavior.
